title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: a bare save or delete counts the holders the bare read counts (ADR-0150 D3/D5)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_

Fixes #34144
Part of #33955
Part of #34262

> #33955 and #34262 are folded into this PR and are closed by the area on merge (seat ruling, 2026-11-16T13:57Z); they are `Part of` so the landing gate reads one delivered card, #34144.

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — a `git grep` of `skills/` finds no text that teaches a bare save or delete of a name two enabled packages hold or only disabled packages hold

> **BREAKING (declared narrowing).** Every moved answer goes from accepted (or, for a bare delete or draft discard over no stored row, the no-op receipt) to refused, and nothing that was refused is now accepted. A bare save in these states that a later gate already refused now answers this 409 first: refused to refused. The changeset carries the ADR-0087 marker (`not-required (no-migration-prescription)`).

> **Follows #33995 (merged).** This branch has `origin/main` with #33995 merged in, and flips #33995's review#2 S3 save pin (`packages/objectql/src/disabled-holder-packageless-row-doors.test.ts`) to this refusal. The pin's delete half, its shipped-member `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` CONTROL and its re-enable CONTROL are unchanged. The FROM and TO are in the table below and in the changeset.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：不带包名保存或删除一个名字时，现在按读取的规则数持有者。两个以上启用中的包持有时，拒绝（409）并列出这些包。只有停用的包持有时，拒绝并提示用 `?package=`，不点名任何包。这两种状态下，没有存储行时的删除和草稿丢弃也从“无操作成功”改为拒绝。
- 为什么改：读取已经这样回答（409 列出两个包，或 404），保存却返回 200，悄悄改写某个包的行，或写出一条读不到的行。这违反 ADR-0150 红线 2（有歧义就报告，不猜），也违反裁决 A。
- 风险与回滚：这是声明过的收窄，原来能保存的现在被拒绝。只影响两种状态，带 `?package=` 的写入和环境自己的条目不变。回滚就是撤销这个 PR，不涉及存储行。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-save.ts` 文件末尾的 `packagelessHolderRefusal` 和两处调用；`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts` 里删除的那一处调用；`packages/objectql/src/disabled-holder-packageless-row-doors.test.ts` 里翻转的 S3 保存断言。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata-protocol build && cd packages/runtime && pnpm exec vitest run --project local src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`，预期 1 个文件、全部用例通过。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

A write that names no package (`PUT` / `DELETE /meta/:type/:name` with no `?package=`, `saveMetaItem` / `deleteMetaItem` with no `packageId`) took its address from the stored rows' bindings alone (`packagelessAddress`), while the bare read counts the name's holders. One new judgment, `packagelessHolderRefusal` in `protocol-save.ts`, runs after the existing judgments (`servedPackagelessSaveAddress` and the two-bindings refusal), so neither of their answers moves. It is asked by the publish-mode bare save, the draft-mode bare save, and the bare delete (`protocol-diff-delete-load.ts`, the delete half only).

- **Two or more enabled holders (#33955, ADR-0150 D3/D5, red line 2).** The judgment asks the package-scoped resolver, `registry.resolveItem(type, name, null, member)`, which the by-name read asks before any layer. When it refuses `ambiguous-in-environment`, the write is refused with the existing `packagelessAddressAmbiguityRefusal`, which names those packages.
- **Only disabled holders (#34144 ruling A, #34262).** When every holder of the name is disabled, the write is refused with `disabledHoldersOnlyRefusal`. Holders here are registry holders, code shippers and stored-row bindings, and a row bound to a disabled holder's customization pair counts as that holder. The refusal is `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` (the same family, no new code) with the `?package=` remedy, and it names no package.
- **Left alone.** A package-unbound row stored at the address, the environment's own item, a type the registry does not read by package, and a registry without the reads.

Commits: one per card, then the #33995 follow-up. #34144 is the disabled-only arm, its pins and the flipped #33889 CONTROL. #33955 is the resolver arm and its pins. #34262 is a pin only: the #34144 arm already covers that cell. After merging `origin/main` (with #33995), one commit flips #33995's S3 save pin and one adds that FROM and TO to the changeset. Then three review#1 commits: the jsdoc gap and the shared recogniser in the resolver catch (N1), the no-row delete pins (S2, N2), and the changeset corrections (S2, N3, N4). At takeover, one commit (e378b62f) adds a sentence to this PR's changeset that supersedes the stale line of `.changeset/33385-disabled-holders-env-404.md` (prose only).

| Door (no package named) | State | FROM | TO |
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
| publish save | only disabled D holds, D's row alone | 200, D's row updated | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `?package=` remedy, no package named; D's row byte-unchanged |
| publish save | only disabled D ships it, no stored row | 200, package-unbound row written (every read withholds it) | 409 as above, nothing written |
| publish save | only disabled D ships it, D's row | 200, D's row updated | 409 as above, row unchanged |
| draft save | only disabled D ships it, no stored row | 200, package-unbound draft written | 409 as above, nothing written |
| delete | only disabled D ships it, D's row | 200, D's row removed | 409 as above, row stays |
| publish save, `email_template` | every holder disabled, a member D never ships (#34262) and the member it ships | 200, package-unbound row stored and withheld | 409 as above, nothing stored |
| publish save, `email_template` (#33995's S3 pin, objectql engine) | the package disabled, `fr-FR`, a member it never ships | `success: true, state: 'active'`, package-less row stored, hidden until re-enable | 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, `?package=` remedy, naming no package, no row stored |
| publish save | two enabled packages ship it, no stored row | 200, package-unbound row written | 409 naming both, nothing written |
| publish save | two enabled ship it, one package's row (either) | 200, that row updated | 409 naming both, row unchanged |
| draft save | two enabled ship it, no stored row | 200, package-unbound draft written | 409 naming both |
| delete | two enabled ship it, E's row | 200, E's row removed | 409 naming both, row stays |
| delete and draft discard (`state: 'draft'`) | two enabled ship it, no stored row | the no-op receipt (`success: true, reset: false`) | 409 naming both |
| delete and draft discard (`state: 'draft'`) | only disabled D ships it, no stored row | the no-op receipt (`success: true, reset: false`) | 409 with the `?package=` remedy, no package named |

Unchanged, pinned as CONTROLs: a row of each of two enabled holders (409 before and after); `?package=D` and `?package=E` saves and deletes; a name one enabled package holds; every #32605 cell (an enabled beside a disabled holder); a name no package holds; a package-unbound row at the address (the save edits it and the delete removes it); and every bare write once the package is enabled again.

## Tests

- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-served-stack.test.ts`, inside the existing #32605 bare-save harness (shared-harness rule). Every new pin runs on a booted kernel, through both transports (the runtime dispatcher and `RestServer`) and in both registration orders. The harness's `put` now takes a query (`?package=`, `?mode=draft`).
  - The #33889 CONTROL "a name only the disabled D holds … is saved as before" is flipped to ruling A's refusal, with `?package=D` and re-enable as CONTROLs.
  - #34144: the bare save over no row and over D's row, the draft save, and the bare delete with the delete naming D as CONTROL. Also the environment's own items.
  - #33955: rows 0 / E's / D's / both, the bare read's 409 beside the save's, the draft save and delete, `?package=E` as CONTROL, and the package-unbound row as CONTROL.
  - #34262: the `email_template` member D never ships and the one it ships, with re-enable as CONTROL.
  - review#1 S2: the bare delete and the bare draft discard over no stored row, one pin per state (`d_norow_dash`, `two_norow_dash`), with the delete naming the package (still the no-op receipt) as CONTROL. Declared and pinned rather than guarded on a row being addressed: over no row the address is just as ambiguous (two enabled holders) or unheld (only disabled holders) as for the save, and ADR-0150 D5 answers an ambiguous bare address 409, "never a silent pick". The no-op receipt's self-heal also restores a registry view at that unresolved address.
  - review#1 N2: the disabled-only delete pins now assert the `?package=` remedy and that no package is named.
- `packages/objectql/src/disabled-holder-packageless-row-doors.test.ts` (#33995's file, an approved extension of this claim's surface): the review#2 S3 save is flipped from "accepted and kept" to the refusal above, and nothing is stored. CONTROLs: the shipped-member `en-US` save is still `403 NOT_OVERRIDABLE` (that gate answers before this judgment), and once the package is enabled again the same `fr-FR` save is kept. The delete half is unchanged: with the package disabled again, a delete naming no package removes the package-less row.
- Refusals assert `code` and `status`, the `?package=` remedy, and which packages are named or not named. The rest of the wording is not pinned.

Every other pin, the row-present delete pins included, stayed green. Restore: blob equal to HEAD (0efc25873118), `git diff HEAD` empty. After the rebuild, `--absent` exit 0 (marker absent from all 24 built files, tree clean), and the file passed again: Tests 136 passed (136).

Result: Tests 16 failed, 112 passed. The 16 are the three new #33955 rows plus the draft and delete pin, in all four cases. The "row of each" CONTROL stayed green, refused by the stored rows' own refusal as before.
- Restore: `git diff HEAD` was empty after both. After the rebuild, `ablation-dist-preflight --absent` passed for both markers (exit 0, exit 0).
- #33995's S3 save pin (objectql), at 0deac3e8a4: the disabled-only anchor replaced with `return void 'ABLATE_S3_34144'`, blob 38624bc72dbf to 0a2d9ce3926e, the marker present in 2 built files. Result: Tests 1 failed, 4 passed; the flipped pin failed with `expected [ undefined, undefined ] to deeply equal [ 409, 'RESOURCE_CONFLICT' ]` (the save accepted). Restored (blob equal to HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty); rebuilt, `--absent` exit 0. A first run used a comment marker the build strips, so its dist proof failed (marker absent) and it is not counted.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Open question closed as A (keep), by the coordinator: a package-unbound row of a name only a disabled package ships (`d_unbound_dash`). The bare read answers 404 and the bare save still edits that row. It is pinned as a measured, unchanged CONTROL: the `?package=` remedy cannot reach a package-unbound row, so refusing would leave no way to write it while the package is disabled. The maintainer's decision on it is #34348.
- Known gap, not fixed here (review#1 S1): two enabled holders whose stored rows are bound to a disabled package and to exactly one enabled holder still save to that holder's row (200) where the read refuses 409; with an enabled and a disabled holder the draft save and the delete still take their address from the rows. The jsdoc of `servedPackagelessSaveAddress` and `packagelessHolderRefusal` names the gap. Carried by #34346.
- The unreleased note `.changeset/33385-disabled-holders-env-404.md` (from #33995) still says the never-shipped-member save "is accepted and kept, as before". That file is not edited here (seat routing). Instead, this PR's changeset names it by filename and says the line is superseded: while every holder is disabled, the save is refused and nothing is stored (commit e378b62f). Both notes ship in the same release.
- Measured: two enabled shippers plus a package-unbound row laid straight into the store. The bare read answers 409, because the registry has not hydrated the row, while the save edits the row, as before. The save keeps the prefer-local rule (ADR-0048).
- The `email_template` save at the member the package ships answered 200 in this harness (a code-registered package), not 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE` as in #33995's harness. Both now refuse while every holder is disabled.

## Follow-ups

- #34346: mixed holders plus a disabled binding, on the publish save, the draft save and the delete (review#1 S1).
- #34348: decision on a package-unbound row beside disabled-only or two enabled holders (review#1 S3).
